title: Charge rational height in exact compressed permanent powering
statement: For positive reduced rational x, h(x^r)=r h(x), h(x/y)<=h(x)+h(y). Explicit nonnegative rational NxN Q has h(per Q)<=B_Q+log2(N!). Therefore exact per(Q)=c per(A)^r with c>0 rational requires r h(per A)<=B_Q+log2(N!)+h(c). A nontrivial permanent height>=1 forbids hiding a superpolynomial exact exponent in simultaneously polynomial matrix dimension, entry BIT length and correction height.
